title: Blue Planet III Is Keeping the Murky Shots to Prove It Is Real
excerpt: When AI can render a perfect ocean, the BBC is keeping the murky shots. Blue Planet III uses no generative AI in any frame, and the plankton, the haze, and the boat in the background are the proof.

title: Camera Sales Are Slipping. Compact Cameras Are Not.
excerpt: Camera sales have slipped for four months running, but compact cameras are the exception: fixed-lens shipments rose about 32 percent in August while interchangeable-lens bodies fell 13 percent. The small camera is the one people actually carry.

title: A Telephoto Turns a Sea of Fog Into a Dozen Photographs
excerpt: Point a 100-400mm zoom at a sea of fog and one washed-out view becomes dozens of small pictures. The long lens is not for getting closer. It is for choosing less.
